run_meta_train_mountain_car: run meta-training for the Mountain Car environment with an MC_Policy and learnable ML3 loss over 300 outer iterations
run_test_ml3_loss_mountain_car: test a trained ML3 loss on the Mountain Car environment and save resulting states to a numpy file
run_mountain_car_exp_train: run the mountain car experiment in train mode with optional shaped loss via command line arguments
run_mountain_car_exp_test: run the mountain car experiment in test mode to evaluate a saved ML3 loss model and render a GIF
create_task_loss_callable: create a Task_loss callable that computes state-to-goal distance loss with optional shaped loss for the first 15 timesteps
